scientific_question: Does the order in which heritable variation for reproductive assurance versus floral investment first becomes available redirect subsequent evolution and small-population persistence under identical historical and future visitor sequences?
relation_to_previous: PR413 independently froze pooled assurance-evolution effect on persistence after outcome-informed demographic grids. This is a separate question and new cohort, not a rescue of failed 64-history first-generation payoff test.
founders: Same 48-source distribution for matching/access, but both investment and assurance loci of every founder clamped exactly at 0.5. New source state prevents selection on locked trait via pre-existing standing variation; mutation is the only initial source of variation in these two traits.
post_shock_protocol: Independently bottleneck each realized t400 genetic population using the same subset RNG for all schedules at matching setting/history/repeat/prehistory; pair future near/far visitor sequences and demographic RNG by setting/history/repeat/destination/budget, NEVER by schedule or prehistory. No plant immigration.
primary_pilot_estimand: For each history and setting, integrate terminal occupancy over 2 post visitor environments ×4 prespecified ovule budgets (eight equally weighted conditions). Compare (far-pre minus near-pre) between assurance_first and investment_first. Report all settings and the equally weighted four-setting descriptive mean. Historical-schedule contrasts are paired at visitor-history level.
secondary_readouts: At generation 150 verify no mutant alleles exist at intentionally locked locus
At generation 150 and 400 mean and variance of I and A
First generation when population mean of I or A deviates from 0.5 by at least 0.05
At generation 400 immediate viable maternal output under a shared post visitor environment
Both-early and both-delayed schedule controls, reported not cherry-picked
inference: Only 4 independent visitor histories with 2 nested repeats. This is an exploratory mechanism pilot; no success gate or confidence interval inferred from demographic pseudo-replication.
claim_boundary: This manipulates the TIME OF MUTATIONAL ACCESS, not directly the observed phenotypic order and not matched total mutational opportunity.
Because initial I and A standing variation are forcibly removed, this is a new founder-genetics scope and cannot be numerically equated to previous 32-history persistence estimates.
Early-access trait has 150 more reproductive updates with mutational supply than late-access trait. Any contrast combines priority and duration of mutational access.
Mutation masks are applied to offspring transmitted alleles, not to reproduction, fitness or expression of existing variants.
No distinct PDE route is claimed and no natural island predictions are calibrated.
Selection, segregation, drift and visitor histories remain active and can produce identical or reversed response even with different mutational access.
All four settings and four schedules must be reported including null/sign-reversed outcomes. No changes to PR411, to failed 64-history 5-condition gate, or to 32-history prior result.
